Fit native sparse multivariate FPCA with an optional frozen-source scientific record

etr_fit_sparse_mfpca.Rd

Estimates direct paired sparse planar mean and covariance surfaces and joint PACE scores with full fitted covariance plus measurement error and optional ridge. No raw trajectory interpolation is introduced. Source-scientific parity on declared domains remains provisional until direct frozen Python tests and independent scientific review succeed.

Usage

etr_fit_sparse_mfpca(trajectories, dimensions = c("x", "y"),
    n_components = 2L, backend = NULL, max_marginal_components = 3L,
    fve = 0.95, options = list(), observation_process = NULL,
    evaluation_grid = NULL, mean_bandwidth = NULL,
    covariance_bandwidth = NULL, measurement_error = "diagonal",
    measurement_error_variance = NULL,
    measurement_error_covariance = NULL,
    analysis_support_action = "error", psd_action = "error",
    psd_tolerance = 1e-8, positive_eigen_tolerance = 1e-10,
    score_ridge = 0, score_condition_limit = 1e12,
    min_score_time_points = 2L, score_failure_action = "error",
    mean_min_local_points = 3L, covariance_min_local_pairs = 6L,
    strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

trajectories

Native irregular paired planar observations.

dimensions

Distinct observed coordinate names (two coordinates).

n_components

Retained number of joint PACE components. Must be supplied explicitly in strict source mode.

backend

Explicit native covariance/PACE estimator "native_covariance", or distinct R marginal "fdapace_joint_score_pca" alternative.

max_marginal_components, fve, options

Controls for the distinct marginal fdapace estimator. Their R defaults must remain unchanged in strict source mode.

observation_process

Reserved native observation-process input, required to be NULL for this fit.

evaluation_grid

Evaluation times for population mean/covariance, distinct from the original raw observations.

mean_bandwidth, covariance_bandwidth

Explicit positive local smoothing bandwidths.

measurement_error

"diagonal" or "fixed_matrix"; must be explicit in strict source mode.

measurement_error_variance

Two nonnegative variance components for diagonal measurement error.

measurement_error_covariance

Explicit positive-semidefinite 2-by-2 noise matrix for correlated measurement error.

analysis_support_action, psd_action

Observed-support and latent-covariance PSD policies.

psd_tolerance, positive_eigen_tolerance

Finite nonnegative PSD and eigenvalue cutoffs.

score_ridge, score_condition_limit

Joint PACE score-system ridge and conditioning limits.

min_score_time_points, score_failure_action

Per-curve score support and retained-failure policy.

mean_min_local_points, covariance_min_local_pairs

Minimum local observed support for mean and covariance smoothers.

strict_source_record

If TRUE, return the frozen Python 1.2 SparseMFPCAResult scientific fields in their exact declared order, without extra R backend fields or Python dataclass impersonation. Default FALSE retains the native R fit and extra diagnostics.

Value

A native sparse multivariate PACE result, or in strict mode a 29-field native R source-scientific result for regression against frozen Python 1.2. This record is not a Python dataclass.
